_metadata.description: When an adoption record goes behind, open an issue in the target scenario via app-issue-tracker's CLI.

requirements.title: Drift transitions trigger a single issue per adoption record
requirements.description: On refresh, when an adoption record's status transitions from current to behind/modified, the service invokes `app-issue-tracker` via its scenario CLI to file an issue in the target scenario's tracker. The issue ID is recorded on the adoption record (`drift_issue_id`) to suppress duplicates on subsequent refreshes.

validation.notes: Service test injects a fake CLI invoker, asserts the CLI command/args, and verifies dedupe on a second refresh.

requirements.title: Integration uses the scenario CLI, never raw HTTP
requirements.description: If app-issue-tracker's CLI lacks a verb needed for this integration, the verb must be added to that CLI first. The library never falls back to direct HTTP calls.

validation.notes: Code review: `rg -n 'http\.|fetch\(' api/internal/adoptions` returns nothing related to issue filing.
